Fonts used for typed text on the page (both SIL Open Font License 1.1, see the OFL-*.txt files).
Files are the Latin subsets published by Fontsource (npm, version 5.2.7).

edu-au-vic-wa-nt-pre-500.woff2   Edu AU VIC WA NT Pre, Medium. Label print as taught in Victoria,
                                  WA and the NT. Copyright 2023 The VIC WA NT School Hand Australia
                                  Project Authors (Tina Anderson, Corey Anderson).
playwrite-au-vic-400.woff2       Playwrite AU VIC, Regular. Based on Victorian Modern Cursive.
                                  Copyright 2023 The Playwrite Project Authors
                                  (https://github.com/TypeTogether/Playwrite).
